_comment: Thresholds marked status=placeholder are NOT calibrated: replace them from the real iFogSim workload/topology and set status to 'calibrated'. Cost reference values are placeholders too.

features.name: task_mi
features.source: TO CONFIRM (Java dev): computational length of the task as known when it is created
features.timing: at task creation, before the offloading decision

features.name: wan_latency_ms
features.source: TO CONFIRM (Java dev): latency of the path to the Cloud (configured link latency or a recent measured RTT)
features.timing: latest value available at decision time (state the staleness)

features.name: edge_utilization
features.unit: fraction 0..1 of edge MIPS in use
features.source: TO CONFIRM (Java dev): utilisation of the edge device that would run the task
features.timing: sampled at decision time, before the task is placed

features.name: deadline_ms
features.source: TO CONFIRM (Java dev): per-task deadline from the workload definition

features.name: device_utilization
features.unit: fraction 0..1 of the originating IoT device CPU in use
